products.name: Oracle SOA Integration for C2M (Web Services & APIs) — Commercial
products.short_description: Define the SOA integration approach for C2M — composites/adapters, inbound/outbound IWS, and API patterns — so integrations are consistent, supportable, and observable, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Integrate C2M with the enterprise via SOA, web services, and APIs

C2M rarely stands alone — it exchanges data with meters, billing, analytics, and enterprise systems, often through Oracle SOA and web services/APIs. This solution defines the SOA integration approach for C2M: composites and adapters between C2M and other systems, inbound/outbound web services (IWS), and API patterns — so integrations are consistent, supportable, and observable, pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M integration model: Oracle SOA composites/adapters, IWS inbound/outbound web services, and API patterns.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (SOA Suite where used, C2M IWS, endpoints/credentials, pilot).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to design and deploy the named SOA composites/adapters and IWS, apply consistent authN/error-handling/observability, and validate the integrations, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (integration flows, errors handled, observable) plus Best Practices for supportable, low-lock-in integration.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M integrated with the enterprise through consistent, supportable, observable patterns — SOA composites, IWS, and APIs — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OSOAC2M-Discovery.py — read-only snapshot of the C2M SOA/web-service integration surface
    • OSOAC2M-Discovery.sql — read-only inventory of C2M integration metadata (companion to OSOAC2M-Discovery.py)
    • OSOAC2M-Remediation.py — create/repair the WebLogic-side C2M integration objects (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OSOAC2M-Report.py — read-only health/coverage report for the C2M SOA-integration surface
    • OSOAC2M-ScopeHelper.sh — resolve and export the C2M SOA-integration target scope for the other scripts
    • OSOAC2M-Validation.py — read-only pass/fail checks for the C2M SOA-integration surface

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
